description.gl: Seis comarcas arredor do cabo do mundo, con 97 nodos: o exemplo de ESCALA da galería.
description.en: Six shires around the cape at the world's end, 97 nodes: the gallery's SCALE example.

description.gl: Onde remata a terra coñecida. Todo o demais é elección.
description.en: Where the known land ends. Everything else is a choice.

description.gl: Quen sabe onde rompe cada onda desta ribeira.
description.en: Who knows where every wave breaks on this shore.

description.gl: O monte non se conquista: cómprase con anos.
description.en: The hill is not conquered: it is bought with years.

description.gl: A fraga non che responde: deixa de esconderche cousas.
description.en: The wood does not answer you: it stops hiding things from you.

description.gl: Saír sen carta e volver igual.
description.en: To sail without a chart and come back all the same.

description.gl: Non manda quen grita: manda a quen se lle debe.
description.en: It is not the loudest who rules, but the one who is owed.

description.gl: Fala pouco. O que di, cúmprese.
description.en: She speaks little. What she says, happens.
